# Cell Annotation — Integrated Atlas

## Setup

```{r libs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

theme_set(theme_classic())
```

```{r load-config}
config_path <- here::here(
  "chapter_2_sc_deconv_benchmarking", "01_sc_matrix",
  "scripts", "02_sc_integration_matrix", "config_integration.R"
)
source(config_path)
```

```{r helper-ens-to-symbol}
ens_to_label <- function(ensembl_ids, seu) {
  if ("gene_symbol" %in% colnames(seu[["RNA"]]@meta.data)) {
    sym <- setNames(seu[["RNA"]]@meta.data$gene_symbol, rownames(seu))
    out <- sym[ensembl_ids]
    out[is.na(out) | out == ""] <- ensembl_ids[is.na(out) | out == ""]
    return(unname(out))
  }
  return(ensembl_ids)
}
```

## 1. Load annotated object

```{r load-object}
seu <- readRDS(annotated_integrated_path)

cat("Dimensions:", nrow(seu), "genes x", ncol(seu), "cells\n")
cat("Datasets:", paste(unique(seu$dataset_id), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Confirm final annotation column is present
if (!"cell_type_final" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
  stop("'cell_type_final' column not found. Run post_integration.qmd first.")
}

cat("Cell types:", paste(sort(unique(seu$cell_type_final)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## 2. Final UMAP

```{r umap-final}
p1 <- DimPlot(seu, group.by = "cell_type_final", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE,
              pt.size = 0.3, label.size = 3) +
        ggtitle("Final annotation") + NoLegend()

p2 <- DimPlot(seu, group.by = "dataset_id", pt.size = 0.3) +
        ggtitle("By dataset")

p1 | p2
```

## 3. Cell type composition

```{r composition-table}
composition <- seu@meta.data |>
  group_by(dataset_id, disease_group, cell_type_final) |>
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(dataset_id) |>
  mutate(pct = n_cells / sum(n_cells) * 100) |>
  arrange(dataset_id, desc(n_cells))

composition
```

```{r composition-barplot}
ggplot(composition,
       aes(x = dataset_id, y = pct, fill = cell_type_final)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Cell type composition per dataset",
       x = NULL, y = "% cells", fill = "Cell type") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r composition-by-condition}
seu@meta.data |>
  group_by(condition, cell_type_final) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = pct, fill = cell_type_final)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Cell type composition: tumor vs normal",
       x = NULL, y = "% cells", fill = "Cell type") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## 4. Marker validation

```{r top-markers-per-type}
markers_path <- file.path(dirname(integrated_seurat_path), "cluster_markers.csv")
markers <- read.csv(markers_path)

markers |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 3) |>
  select(cluster, gene, avg_log2FC, p_val_adj)
```

```{r dotplot-final}
Idents(seu) <- "cell_type_final"

top_markers <- markers |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 2) |>
  pull(gene) |>
  unique()

DotPlot(seu, features = ens_to_label(top_markers, seu)) + RotatedAxis()
```

## 5. Malignant vs normal epithelium (inferCNV)

```{r infercnv-check}
# inferCNV results (script 14) should have added a 'malignant' or
# 'cnv_score' column. Adjust column name as needed.
if ("is_malignant" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
  seu@meta.data |>
    filter(grepl("Epithelial|Tumor", cell_type_final, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
    group_by(cell_type_final, is_malignant) |>
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
}
```
